name: project-lens
description: Open an in-app browser project lens for the current project folder.

interface.shortDescription: Browse and inspect the current project as a file tree.
interface.longDescription: Starts a local web app and opens it in Codex's in-app browser. The app renders the current project folder with @pierre/trees and exposes selection, refresh, file preview, and Git status indicators.
defaultPrompt: Browse this repo in the file tree.
